Subject: EdgeWave summit — sponsorship asset ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for sponsoring our breakout session at EdgeWave Summit (Sept 8). Two quick asks from the program team that we hope Redwood can help with:

1) A compact one-page case vignette (single-sided PDF) that highlights the customer impact story for the session (300–400 words, 3 bullets of outcomes, one short quote). We’ll put this in the attendee pack and on the stage iPad.

2) A 30-second demo clip script + sample shot list — the AV crew prefers a tight brief rather than a full video. We’ll handle filming on-site if you provide the script and brand-safe notes.

I attached the sponsor asset guidelines and our preferred spec doc (demo-clip-guidelines.docx). Can you confirm who at Redwood will own each asset and whether you can deliver by EOD Sep 2?

Best,
Sophie

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. Two quick clarifications:

1) Quote — you can use an anonymized attribution: "CPO, Atlas (EdgeWave customer)" — that’ll keep legal simple.
2) Architecture diagram — please do NOT include a full blown architecture. A single-line icon callout that says "Deployed on Redwood Dedicated with KV cache" is perfect.
